training_protocol.balanced_ids: arange(T * topk) % E, reshaped to [T, topk]
training_protocol.hot16_ids: moe_benchmark.make_inputs(pattern='hot') with E=128; its fixed helper selects 16 experts
training_protocol.same_inputs_across_routes: same seed per T; X, gate_up, down, and routing weights match; only IDs differ

scope: complete ranked fixed-route BF16 MoE forward; shared GU/down config; no router or serving stack

selection_rule.shape_only_mu: T * topk / E; no GPU counts readback or route-value selection
selection_rule.recheck_failure_action: fallback to baseline; do not try the next-ranked config

timing_protocol.reported_unit: milliseconds per complete forward, event time divided by calls and graph forward count
timing_protocol.theoretical_flops_per_forward: 6 * T * topk * H * I; derived throughput is not a hardware counter

holdout_policy: M5 seeds 73/991 and T193/1024/2049 are not read or used for selection; run them only after freeze

timing.wall_scope: includes event recording and end synchronization; not isolated host-launch latency
